name: What factors should I consider when choosing a new bathroom faucet?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a new bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a new bathroom faucet, consider the type of sink and number of pre-drilled holes you have (single-hole, centerset, widespread). Also, think about the finish that complements your bathroom decor, the type of handle (lever, knob, touchless), and the faucet's overall durability and water efficiency. Compatibility with your existing plumbing is crucial for an easy installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your sink type, pre-drilled holes, finish, handle style, durability, and water efficiency when choosing a faucet.
